decision_question: How should two stable peers be coordinated before evidence exists that a learned orchestrator adds value?
frozen_input: Neta and R&D are peer methods under shared epistemic constraints. Repeated tasks require routing between peers and external authorities. Coordination must remain auditable, preserve authority boundaries, and avoid turning peer agreement into truth.
known_constraints: No peer owns the other
Routing decisions must be inspectable
A learned orchestrator must be earned by observed coordination failure

decision_question: Where should provider/model-specific execution concerns live relative to the calibration routing law?
frozen_input: The calibration runtime must invoke R&D, Neta and Scaffold, but provider, model and local command choices may change. API keys must stay outside the repository. The routing law should not need modification when an inference provider changes.
known_constraints: No secrets in repository
Routing semantics must remain provider-neutral
Resource identity and failure must remain explicit

decision_question: How should current repository truth be represented when many historical branches contain lineage and some unique artifacts?
frozen_input: The repository accumulated multiple long-lived historical branches. Some were ancestors, some diverged, and useful historical artifacts still needed preservation. Opening an old branch to discover current truth creates ambiguity about authority.
known_constraints: Historical lineage must remain recoverable
There must be one current source of truth
Useful unique artifacts must not be silently lost

decision_question: Does architecture reasoning require a new autonomous peer now?
frozen_input: Architecture questions recur, but R&D can allocate resources, Scaffold can provide broad architecture reasoning, and REPO/ENVIRONMENT can establish structural/runtime facts. It is unknown whether an architecture-specific method adds unique decision value.
known_constraints: New peers must be earned by decision delta
Architecture authority cannot replace REPO/ENVIRONMENT facts
Avoid building a full agent to test whether a smaller capability is useful

decision_question: Should research continuity remain the top-level R&D purpose after a broader resource-allocation problem becomes visible?
frozen_input: R&D v0.1 preserves research continuity well. Live work also requires deciding whether research is worth buying at all, whether existing capabilities should be reused/adapted/retired, and which resource is the cheapest path to a live telos.
known_constraints: Keep the existing comparator intact
Research is valuable but may be globally wasteful
R&D must not inherit OWNER authority

decision_question: How should a flat documentation directory with poor discoverability be reorganized when many code comments/tests cite existing paths?
frozen_input: Sixteen documents exist; the top README links only five. Two documents overlap on deployment/verification, and two similarly named measurement documents cover different subjects. Moving documents into subdirectories would break one runtime test and make roughly fifty path citations stale.
known_constraints: Improve discoverability
Preserve current code/test references where possible
Do not confuse measured records with argued documents

decision_question: How should production verification classify an alias mismatch when a newer deployment legitimately superseded the commit being checked?
frozen_input: A production smoke assertion compares the served commit to the commit that triggered deployment. Close merges can move the production alias to a newer valid deployment before the older deployment event runs. A naive mismatch rule makes the default branch red even though production is healthy, but weakening the assertion could hide rollback/stale failures.
known_constraints: Exact deployed-commit verification must remain meaningful
Superseded is not broken
Older rollback, empty ancestry or malformed evidence must not silently pass

decision_question: Where should long file-level explanation live, and should prose and executable code share one weight budget?
frozen_input: Sixteen asset files contain 21+ line orientation headers. Hundreds of line-bound comments explain the statement immediately below them. A single asset-size ceiling currently treats comments/prose and executable dependencies as the same kind of weight, while measurement shows they compress differently.
known_constraints: Local constraints needed at edit time should remain local
Orientation prose should be discoverable without dominating source files
Budget changes should identify what kind of weight moved

decision_question: When should duplicated browser-test infrastructure become a shared harness, and how broadly should the refactor propagate?
frozen_input: New PRE-CALL and POST-CALL suites duplicate server startup, Playwright lookup and one-profile-per-test setup. The same pattern has now been copied four times. Existing journey/a11y/perf suites are green and use their own working setup.
known_constraints: Reduce repeated harness logic where it is actively multiplying
Do not rewrite unrelated passing suites without behavioral gain
Preserve test isolation

decision_question: What state should be persisted to restore a chess position across a return without creating duplicate truth or corrupting think-time measurement?
frozen_input: The current record persists but the board position does not, so return starts at the opening. Board snapshots are derivable from the move sequence through existing history-building logic. A half-answered draft decision also contains a think-time clock that would become invalid after a long absence.
known_constraints: Avoid two sources of truth for one board
Reuse the same derivation path as pasted PGN
Do not turn elapsed absence into measured thinking time

decision_question: How should open technical/research debt be represented when several existing documents are each authoritative for different slices but no single document answers what is currently open?
frozen_input: Production readiness history, action plan, blitz audit and ADRs all contain relevant debt/status information and disagree in scope/time. Replacing them would erase their distinct authority. Some claims are verified in the tree and others remain asserted.
known_constraints: Preserve each existing document's legitimate purpose
Create one usable answer to what is open now
Do not treat assertion as verified repository fact

decision_question: How can a concise outcome summary be added without becoming a second source of truth for claims, scores, thresholds or actions?
frozen_input: The Record page contains multiple calibrated modules and a claim/grade, but a returning player must reconstruct the answer from instrumentation. Existing modules already own detection, grading, remaining-before-claim logic, actions and caveats.
known_constraints: Summary must not detect/score/threshold independently
Every statement must retain source authority
Do not duplicate action ownership
